name: Emailcampaigns.eu for WooCommerce
author: Emailcampaigns.eu

sections.description:
Turn your WooCommerce data into email marketing that drives repeat sales.

Your customers are already showing you what they are interested in. They browse products, add items to their carts, place orders, come back for another purchase, or disappear for a while.

Emailcampaigns.eu helps you turn that activity into relevant email communication.

Connect your store once and keep customer, order, cart and website activity data available for your email marketing. Use it to create targeted campaigns, personalized messages, useful customer segments and automated journeys without repeatedly exporting and importing CSV files.

Try Emailcampaigns.eu free for 30 days and send up to 5,000 emails. No credit card required.

Your WooCommerce data. Ready when your marketing needs it.

The plugin keeps selected store data connected with your email marketing account, so you can spend less time moving information between systems and more time actually using it.

Keep contacts automatically up to date

Customer data can be synchronized from:

  • WooCommerce orders
  • Customer registrations
  • Newsletter subscriptions
  • Contacts who should not receive newsletters

Contacts are automatically organized into dedicated groups, helping you understand where they came from and how they should be used.

Add purchase context to your customer data

An email address tells you who someone is. Their orders, purchased products and customer attributes tell you much more. Use this information to build audiences around actual customer relationships instead of maintaining separate lists manually.

Understand what happens before the purchas

Cart tracking captures products customers add, remove or update before checkout. Website tracking can add selected browsing activity for known customers, giving you another layer of context for segmentation and automation.

Collect newsletter subscriptions at checkout

Give customers the option to subscribe while completing their order. The configurable newsletter consent option supports both classic checkout and WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks.

Bring your existing customers and orders with you

Already have an established store?
Bulk synchronization brings existing WooCommerce users and orders into your account in the background, so you can start working with the data you already have instead of rebuilding your customer database from scratch.

Turn customer activity into the next right message

Once your data is connected, you can use it throughout the customer journey.

  • Bring abandoned shoppers back
    Use cart activity to automatically follow up with customers who showed buying intent but left before completing their purchase.

  • Keep the conversation going after an order
    A purchase does not have to be the end of the customer journey. Follow up with relevant content, recommend complementary products, ask for feedback or encourage the next purchase.

  • Reconnect with inactive customers
    Identify customers who have not purchased for a while and create communication specifically designed to bring them back.

  • Reach customers when it is time to reorder
    Sell products customers buy regularly? Use purchase history to reach them around the time they may need another one.

  • Give different customers different messages
    A first time buyer, a loyal repeat customer and someone who abandoned a cart should not all receive the same campaign. Build audiences around purchase history, products, activity and customer attributes, then tailor the communication to each group.

  • Welcome new contacts automatically
    Turn new registrations and newsletter subscriptions into the beginning of a customer journey with automated welcome communication.

Go beyond basic email marketing

Your store gives you the data.

Emailcampaigns.eu gives you the tools to turn it into communication that reaches the right audience, reflects your brand and can be measured.

Build emails without touching code

Create responsive campaigns in an intuitive editor and choose from more than 120 ready to use templates. Start with an existing design or create communication that matches your own brand without writing HTML.

Personalize more than a greeting

Go beyond inserting a first name. Use customer data to adapt communication based on interests, purchases, activity and the relationship each customer has with your business.

Build segments around real customer behavior

Separate first time customers from repeat buyers. Find inactive customers. Target people who purchased a specific product or match conditions that matter to your business. Use the data already available in your account to create audiences that are more useful than manually maintained static lists.

Automate communication that should happen at the right moment

Set up customer journeys once and let automation handle the timing.

Welcome new contacts, recover abandoned carts, follow up after purchases, remind customers to reorder or reactivate inactive buyers.

Need something more specific? Contact us and we will help you design automation scenarios tailored to your customer journey, business goals and available data.

Create faster with AI assisted tools

Use AI assisted tools to generate or refine copy, subject lines, images and other campaign elements while keeping the final result under your control. Spend less time starting from a blank page and more time improving the campaign you actually want to send.

See what happens after Send

Use reports and statistics to track delivery, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, heatmaps and other engagement data. Compare campaign performance over time and, with ecommerce tracking in place, connect email activity with orders and revenue to better understand which campaigns contribute to your business results.

Connect more of your marketing ecosystem

Customer data rarely lives in just one system.

Connect CRM, ERP, ecommerce, automation and other business tools, or build your own integration using the API Explore all integrations.

You can also add SMS campaigns when timing matters more than space for content and design. Use SMS for time sensitive promotions, notifications, reminders, discount codes and other customer communication. Explore SMS campaigns

External services

This plugin connects to the Emailcampaigns.eu and Emailkampane.cz email marketing platform, which is operated by Commerce Media s.r.o. External communication is essential to the plugin’s purpose and starts only after the site administrator enters valid account credentials or enables relevant tracking features.

Endpoints contacted:

  • https://api.emailkampane.cz/ — JSON REST API used for contact synchronization, contact group management, attribute management, order metadata processing and GDPR data export or erasure. Authentication uses a JWT token obtained from the /get_session endpoint with the administrator’s account email address and API hash.
  • https://tr-web.emailkampane.cz/tracking-code — used after credentials are saved or when the administrator manually refreshes the tracking key. The plugin sends the site name and URL.
  • https://tr-fe.emailkampane.cz/v1/app.min.js and https://tr-fe.emailkampane.cz/v1/app-starter.min.js — frontend tracking scripts loaded when a tracking key is configured and the relevant tracking settings are enabled. Loading respects the configured cookie consent integration.

Data that may be sent:

  • Contact synchronization: email address, first name, last name, city, phone number, company, country, postal code and newsletter consent status.
  • Order tracking: order ID, total, currency, products and customer email address after order completion.
  • Cart tracking: products added, removed or updated in the cart.
  • Page visit tracking: page URL and referrer.
  • Tracking key request: site name and site URL.

Service provider:

  • Emailcampaigns.eu and Emailkampane.cz
  • Commerce Media s.r.o.
  • Lovosická 711/30, 190 00 Prague 9, Czech Republic
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

No contact data is synchronized until the site administrator saves valid credentials. Frontend tracking options are disabled by default. Individual synchronization and tracking features can be disabled in WooCommerce → Settings → Emailcampaigns.eu.
sections.installation:
Getting started does not require rebuilding your existing setup.

1. Install and activate the plugin
Install Emailcampaigns.eu for WooCommerce from your WordPress administration and activate it. Then go to WooCommerce → Settings → Emailcampaigns.eu.

2. Connect your account
Enter the email address associated with your account and your API hash. Request your Tracking Key, save the settings and verify the connection.

3. Choose what you want to synchronize
Select the customer data and attributes you want to use. Create the default contact groups and run bulk synchronization if you want to bring existing customers and orders into your account.

4. Enable the tracking you need
Choose whether to enable cart tracking, completed order tracking and website activity tracking. Configure your preferred consent solution where required.

5. Start using your data
Your selected customer and shopping data is now ready for segmentation, personalization, automation and campaign reporting. View the complete WooCommerce setup guide.
sections.faq:
What is Emailcampaigns.eu?

Emailcampaigns.eu is an email marketing service for creating newsletters, automated campaigns, personalized emails, customer segments and detailed reports. Connected with your store, it lets you bring customer and shopping data into the same environment where you create, automate and evaluate your marketing communication. Explore Emailcampaigns.eu

Do I need an Emailcampaigns.eu account?

Yes. An active account is required to connect your store. If you are new to Emailcampaigns.eu, you can try it free for 30 days and send up to 5,000 emails during your trial. No credit card is required. During the trial, you can explore campaign creation, the email editor, ready to use templates, contact management, segmentation, personalization, automation, reporting and other available features.

Where can I find the API hash?

Log in to Emailcampaigns.eu and open the API settings. Copy the API hash and enter it together with your account email address in WooCommerce → Settings → Emailcampaigns.eu.

What is the Tracking Key used for?

The Tracking Key connects website, cart and order activity with your account. Generate it from the plugin settings after entering valid account credentials.

Can I synchronize existing users and orders?

Yes. Bulk synchronization imports existing WooCommerce users and orders in the background through Action Scheduler. Progress can be monitored from the plugin settings and the process can be cancelled.

Which contact groups does the plugin create?

The plugin creates four groups:
* Orders
* Registrations
* Newsletter Subscription
* Do Not Send Newsletters

How does the plugin handle newsletter subscriptions and consent?

The plugin can add a configurable newsletter subscription option directly to checkout. Contacts can also be organized according to their source and newsletter status, including contacts that should not receive newsletters. The integration supports WordPress Privacy Tools as well as several cookie consent solutions for frontend tracking.

Is the plugin compatible with HPOS and block checkout?

Yes. It supports WooCommerce High Performance Order Storage and WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks.

Which cookie consent solutions are supported?

The plugin supports Complianz, CookieBot, CookieYes and custom consent implementations.

Can I customize the newsletter checkbox?

Yes. You can configure its text and default state. To override the template, copy: templates/checkout-optin-checkbox.php to: your-theme/emailkampane/checkout-optin-checkbox.php

How does the plugin support privacy requests?

It integrates with WordPress Privacy Tools for personal data export and erasure. The administrator can also configure whether contacts without newsletter consent should be synchronized.

What if I need help setting everything up?

Start with the step by step WooCommerce setup guide, which walks you through installation, account connection, synchronization and tracking settings.

You can also browse the Emailcampaigns.eu Knowledge Base or contact our support team if you need help with the integration or want to get more from your ecommerce email marketing.

Contact Emailcampaigns.eu support
sections.changelog:
1.1.10

  • Aligned runtime get_option() fallbacks with the defaults configured in Settings.
  • Changed the fallback values for cart and page visit tracking from enabled to disabled.
  • Ensured that no tracking script loads on a fresh installation before the administrator saves the relevant options.
  • Ensured that the starter tracking script loads only when a tracking key is configured.

1.1.9

  • Updated the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy URLs in readme.txt.

1.1.8

  • Set all frontend tracking and opt-in defaults to disabled.
  • Removed automatic tracking key retrieval.
  • Added contributors to readme.txt.

1.1.7

  • Shortened the description to comply with the WordPress.org 150-character limit.

1.1.6

  • Added translator comments and ordered placeholders.
  • Replaced direct file deletion with wp_delete_file().
  • Added an English short description.
  • Removed manual load_plugin_textdomain() usage.
  • Prefixed global variables in the uninstall process.
  • Added phpcs:ignore comments for legitimate false positives.

1.1.5

  • Enabled the newsletter checkbox option by default.
  • Set the checkbox default state to selected.
  • Added new GDPR-friendly default checkbox text.

1.1.4

  • Changed the text domain to emailcampaigns-eu.
  • Renamed translation files to match the WordPress.org slug.
  • Updated compatibility information to WordPress 7.0.
  • Updated Czech translations.

1.1.3

  • Changed the plugin header to the official name Emailcampaigns.eu.
  • Added localized Emailkampane.cz branding for Czech and Slovak users.
  • Added localized plugin URI and description.
  • Added a documentation link to the plugin list in WordPress administration.
  • Improved Czech translations.

1.1.2

  • Improved locale fallback for non-Czech and non-Slovak administration languages.
  • Updated the newsletter checkbox text to use the current locale dynamically.
  • Replaced the stored default checkbox text with a placeholder.

1.1.1

  • Added an English fallback for non-Czech and non-Slovak locales.
  • Updated the English brand name to Emailcampaigns.eu.
  • Moved the tracking key refresh button next to the tracking key field.
  • Added a warning when connection verification succeeds but the tracking key is missing.
  • Added tracking key status information.
  • Added four Czech and English information and documentation links to the welcome notice and settings header.
  • Improved bulk synchronization status handling so that an empty synchronization is distinguished from an active process.
  • Increased the width of the first settings column for better readability.
  • Added record IDs to bulk synchronization error logs.
  • Added DOKUMENTACE.md with installation, configuration, hooks and troubleshooting information.
  • Updated all 147 Czech and English translation strings.

1.1.0

  • Added the X-Consumer-Identification: WP_WOOCOMMERCE header to all requests sent to api.emailkampane.cz.
  • Added protected system contact groups using protected: "D" and a unique protected_type.
  • Added automatic tracking key retrieval from tr-web.emailkampane.cz/tracking-code after credentials are saved, together with manual refresh.
  • Added background bulk synchronization through Action Scheduler without a database-size limit, including progress information and cancellation.

1.0.0

  • Initial stable release.
  • Added contact synchronization and cart and order tracking.
  • Added newsletter checkbox support for classic and block checkout.
  • Added the log viewer, bulk synchronization and privacy integration.
